posts.title: Failing Hard Disk Drive
posts.description: I have a couple of the Seagate 3000GB drives from a few years ago which are known to fail. Files sporadically became unreadable. Running the MS Windows built-in check disk command didn't recognize any errors. From a command window, the check disk syntax is: chkdsk driveletter: like "chkdsk d:". Check disk completed without finding errors.

posts.title: Privacy and Yahoo email summaries
posts.description: Yahoo mail recently introduced email summaries which are auto-generated and display above the email. This was a surprising change which is intrusive and annoying. From the settings in email, there does not appear to be a method to disable the summaries.The Yahoo brand owns "oath" which provides security and privacy settings.
